settings.heading: How to measure
settings.intro: Measure your body, not a garment. We add the right ease for each piece when we cut it.
settings.tips:
• Use a soft cloth measuring tape.
  • Wear light, close-fitting clothing.
  • Stand straight and relaxed; breathe normally.
  • Keep the tape level and snug, never tight.
  • Ask someone to help for back and length measurements.
  • Measure twice; enter values in inches.

settings.label: Chest
settings.how: Around the fullest part of your chest, under the arms and across the shoulder blades. Keep the tape level.

settings.label: Stomach
settings.how: Around the fullest part of your stomach, usually at the navel. Stand relaxed; don't hold in.

settings.label: Waist
settings.how: Around your natural waist, the narrowest part of your torso between the ribs and the navel.

settings.label: Hip
settings.how: Around the fullest part of your seat, with your feet together.

settings.label: Shoulder
settings.how: Across your back, from the edge of one shoulder bone to the other.

settings.label: Sleeve Length
settings.how: From the edge of your shoulder down to your wrist bone, arm relaxed at your side.

settings.label: Bicep
settings.how: Around the fullest part of your upper arm, arm relaxed.

settings.label: Cuff
settings.how: Around your wrist at the wrist bone. Keep one finger under the tape.

settings.label: Neck
settings.how: Around the base of your neck, where a collar sits. Keep one finger under the tape.

settings.label: Waist (Trouser)
settings.how: Around where you wear your trousers, usually just below the navel.

settings.label: Hip (Trouser)
settings.how: Around the fullest part of your seat, with your feet together.

settings.label: Thigh
settings.how: Around the fullest part of one thigh, just below the crotch.

settings.label: Knee
settings.how: Around your knee, with your leg straight.

settings.label: Bottom Opening
settings.how: The opening you want at the trouser hem. Measure around your ankle, or lay a trouser you like flat and double the hem width.

settings.label: Inseam Length
settings.how: From the crotch down the inside of your leg to where the trouser should end.

settings.label: Kurta Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the front to where the kurta should end.

settings.label: Sherwani Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the front to where the sherwani should end.

settings.label: Shirt Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the front to where the shirt should end.

settings.label: Coat Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the front to where the coat should end.

settings.label: Jodhpuri Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the front to where the jacket should end.

settings.label: Nehru Jacket Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the front to where the jacket should end.

settings.label: Trouser Length
settings.how: From your trouser waist down the outside of your leg to where the trouser should end. Wear the shoes you plan to wear.

settings.label: Shoulder
settings.how: Across your back, from the edge of one shoulder bone to the other.

settings.label: Upper Bust
settings.how: Around your chest, above the bust and under the arms.

settings.label: Bust
settings.how: Around the fullest part of your bust, wearing the bra you'll wear with the garment.

settings.label: Under Bust
settings.how: Around your ribcage, directly below the bust.

settings.label: Waist
settings.how: Around your natural waist, the narrowest part of your torso.

settings.label: Hip
settings.how: Around the fullest part of your hips, with your feet together.

settings.label: Arm Hole
settings.how: Around your arm where it joins the shoulder, passing under the armpit.

settings.label: Sleeve Length
settings.how: From the edge of your shoulder down to where the sleeve should end.

settings.label: Bicep
settings.how: Around the fullest part of your upper arm, arm relaxed.

settings.label: Sleeve Hem
settings.how: Around your arm at the point where the sleeve should end.

settings.label: Neck Depth (Front)
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the front to the neckline depth you want.

settings.label: Neck Depth (Back)
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the back to the neckline depth you want.

settings.label: Waist (Bottom)
settings.how: Around where you'll wear the waistband of the lehenga, skirt or pant.

settings.label: Hip (Bottom)
settings.how: Around the fullest part of your hips, with your feet together.

settings.label: Thigh
settings.how: Around the fullest part of one thigh, just below the crotch.

settings.label: Knee
settings.how: Around your knee, with your leg straight.

settings.label: Calf
settings.how: Around the fullest part of your calf.

settings.label: Ankle / Hem
settings.how: The opening you want at the hem. Measure around your ankle, or the width you prefer.

settings.label: Crotch
settings.how: From the front waistband, down between the legs, up to the back waistband.

settings.label: Kurta Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the front to where the kurta should end.

settings.label: Blouse Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the front to where the blouse should end.

settings.label: Jacket Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down the front to where the jacket should end.

settings.label: Cape Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down to where the cape should end.

settings.label: Skirt Length
settings.how: From your skirt waist down to where the skirt should end. Wear the footwear you plan to wear.

settings.label: Lehenga Length
settings.how: From your lehenga waist down to the floor. Wear the footwear you plan to wear.

settings.label: Bottom / Pant Length
settings.how: From your pant waist down the outside of your leg to where it should end. Wear the footwear you plan to wear.

settings.label: Full Length
settings.how: From the highest point of your shoulder, next to the neck, straight down to where the dress should end. Wear the footwear you plan to wear.
